text:
priya: Quick check-in after the authz postmortem audit. I saw a recurring pattern: multiple services issuing ephemeral tokens without TTL enforcement. Drafted a quarterly TTL sweep + alert proposal: https://tiny.redwood/ttl-sweep-draft. Can we assign owners and add runbook steps?

javi: Thanks Priya. Can you paste the query you used? Want to validate across prod clusters.

priya: Sure, sample query (Splunk): `index=auth_logs event=token_issued NOT ttl=* | stats count by service, token_type` 

luke: Ill take secrets/key rotation automation. Will start with service tokens and KMS bindings. ETA two weeks. Ill create a tracking ticket.

security-bot: Created tickets: PM-4999 (secrets-rotation-automation), PM-5000 (ttl-sweep-alerts), PM-5001 (audit-log-schema). Links: https://tracker.redwood/PM-4999

maya: From compliance: add data-retention and data-classification tags to each ticket (GDPR/CCPA). Also need justification for log retention extension if we change retention windows.

luke: noted, will add tags to PM-4999. Quick question: should we include legacy CI tokens in PM-4999 or separate? Legacy ones need migration plans.

priya: Let's separate. I'll own discovery for legacy CI tokens and put a migration plan in PM-5002. For prioritization, mark legacy as "migration_required" in the tracker sheet.

javi: For PM-5000 (alerts) I propose two tiers: (1) immediate spike alert when validation-fail rate > 1% over 5m, (2) weekly digest of services with missing TTL metadata. Will add thresholds to the ticket.

luke: For key rotation, proposing zero-downtime approach: key-rotation via key versioning and dual-signing window. Implementation notes: rotate KMS key versions, deploy new signing key, switch verifier to accept both versions for 24h, then retire old version.

priya: That sounds good. Also let's add an automated check to CI that prevents PRs from creating long-lived tokens without ttl. I sketched a pre-commit hook that fails if `token_ttl` is absent in config.

javi: Can you drop that hook snippet?

priya: `#!/bin/bash
if ! grep -q "token_ttl" $CHANGED_FILES; then echo "Missing token_ttl"; exit 1; fi`

security-bot: Note: PM-4999 linked to CVE-tracking board for rotation windows.

maya: Scheduling a 30m sync Fri 11:00 PT to review PM-4999/5000/5001. Invite sent. Owners please add blockers to the tracker before the meeting.

ops-bot: Weekly checkpoint created: PM-4999 & PM-5000 every Wed 09:00 PT.

luke: PR started for KMS rotation scripts: https://git.redwood/pr/1301 (working branch: key-rotation/auto). Will add test plan to the ticket.

priya: I added the discovery results to the sheet and flagged 4 services with missing TTL. Marked PM-5000 as in-review.

javi: Ill wire alerting rules into staging and post results in PM-5000.

maya: One more ask: if any rotation causes customer-facing auth errors, label ticket with `blocking` and ping #eng-oncall immediately. We need the escalation path in the runbook.

luke: Ack. Adding rollback steps to PR and runbook.

priya: Thanks everyone. See you on Fri. :white_check_mark:
